backend/main.mo: Motoko canister defining inventory, sales, customers, suppliers, closures, and related data types with storage maps and mixins for authorization and blob storage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, affected files, components, and test IDs for build packaging and artifact download functionality.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of multiple frontend source files describing their responsibilities across routing, UI, hooks, and pages.
frontend/artifacts/.gitkeep: Placeholder file to keep the artifacts directory under version control.
frontend/artifacts/DEPLOY_README.md: Deployment guide explaining ZIP contents, prerequisites, and steps to deploy backend and frontend builds.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration defining design tokens, light/dark theme variables, and base styling.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file mounting the React app and loading the main TypeScript entry point.
frontend/scripts/package-artifact.sh: Shell script that builds backend and frontend, stages outputs, and produces a ZIP artifact with deployment instructions.
frontend/scripts/README.md: Documentation for packaging scripts that build backend and frontend and assemble a deployable ZIP artifact.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with all ERP routes inside the main AppLayout and provides the router to the app.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthControl: Authentication control component handling Internet Identity login/logout and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/customers/Overdu: Displays an overdue credit alert badge or full alert with localized text based on customer name or item count.
frontend/src/components/inventory/Invent: Form dialog for creating or editing inventory items, handling authentication, pricing calculation, and optional image upload.
frontend/src/components/LargeButton.tsx: Large-sized button wrapper applying consistent sizing and styling around the shadcn Button component.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main application layout with navigation, global search trigger, data exports, and auth bootstrap logic.
frontend/src/components/sales/SalesError: Error boundary wrapping sales components, showing a descriptive error card with retry and reload options.
frontend/src/components/search/GlobalSea: Modal search interface that debounces queries, fetches product results, and navigates on selection.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthBootstrap.ts: Auto-initializes user profiles after login, creating a default profile if none exists.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebounce.ts: Provides a debounced version of a changing value using a timeout.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, including loading, login, and error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating inventory, rates, customers, and related backend data via an actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup with light/dark theme variables and base styling rules.
frontend/src/lib/csvExport.ts: Utility functions to escape values, generate CSV strings, and trigger CSV file downloads.
frontend/src/lib/currency.ts: Formats USD, VES, and COP values and converts USD amounts using exchange rates.
frontend/src/lib/datasetSerializers.ts: Serializes inventory, customer, cashbox, and exchange rate data into row arrays for CSV export and defines header labels.
frontend/src/lib/errorMessage.ts: Extracts readable messages from various error types, including IC-specific error patterns.
frontend/src/lib/fileToBytes.ts: Converts files to byte arrays and creates image URLs from byte data.
frontend/src/lib/i18n.ts: Defines a centralized set of typed Spanish translation keys for the app.
frontend/src/lib/inventoryPricing.ts: Provides helpers to compute prices from margins and margins from prices.
frontend/src/lib/salesCart.ts: Implements cart operations such as cloning inventory items, validating stock, calculating totals, and adding/updating/removing cart items.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Provides utility helpers including a Tailwind class merger and a simple unique ID generator.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with react-query and Internet Identity providers and mounts it to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/CashboxPage.tsx: Displays cashbox balances, lists entries with filtering, and provides a form to add new cashbox records.
frontend/src/pages/ClosuresPage.tsx: Shows cashbox closure history and allows creating new closures by calculating balances and income/expenses.
frontend/src/pages/CustomerDetailPage.ts: Shows detailed info for a customer, including debt and overdue sales, with navigation and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/CustomersPage.tsx: Lists customers, highlights overdue ones, and includes a dialog for adding new customers with authentication checks.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Provides KPIs, alerts, analytics, and build info by aggregating inventory, customer, cashbox, and sales data.
frontend/src/pages/InventoryPage.tsx: Displays inventory with category filtering, low-stock alerts, and a form for adding or editing items.
frontend/src/pages/RatesPage.tsx: Shows latest exchange rates and provides an authenticated form to submit new rate entries.
frontend/src/pages/SalesPage.tsx: Implements product search, cart management, and sale submission with stock validation and customer handling.
frontend/src/pages/SupplierDetailPage.ts: Loads and displays detailed supplier info with navigation and not-found handling.
frontend/src/pages/SuppliersPage.tsx: Lists suppliers and includes an authenticated dialog for creating new supplier entries.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, custom colors, typography, container queries, animations, and extended theme settings.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s state, including existing features, a new feature request for creating a ZIP build artifact, and notes about a prior build failure.
